Riya (CSM): FYI - Galileo Health flagged by monitoring. Generation route DAU down ~50% last 4 days. Renewal ~4 weeks. Link: https://redwood.app/metrics/galileo

Tom (AE): Yikes. Do we know if champion still there? Any procurement chatter?

Riya (CSM): Champion Asha moved teams last month. New contact is Eng lead Marco - low responses. Finance asked for usage justification two days ago.

Sofia (CS Ops): Quick check: no 5xx. p95 latency increased from 600ms -> 1.2s over the last 72h. Embedding calls stable, generation calls down.

Ethan (Product): We rolled a token-budget variant ~12 days ago for cost tests. Could be routing. I'll query routing history for their account.

SupportBot: Created ticket G-9033 and requested sample payloads from Marco. ETA ticket update 1h.

Tom (AE): If they're testing competitors, we should offer a short stability trial. Suggest 30-day Dedicated preview with credits. Legal ok with quick SOW?

Riya (CSM): Customer reports "cut off responses" in UI. Might be max_tokens or variant heuristics. Sofia, can you reproduce with their typical prompts?

Sofia (CS Ops): Will run a small prompt-eval today. Also checking SDK versions - older SDKs may change retry/backoff.

Ethan (Product): Confirmed some of their requests hit the budgeted variant. I'll prepare a rollback plan to A/B 10% traffic to prior variant if they allow.

Tom (AE): I'll request an executive touch and propose the trial by EOD. Also looping finance for one-off credits.

Riya (CSM): Action owners: Tom exec+offer, Ethan routing + revert test, Sofia repro + SDK check, SupportBot ticket handling. Update here when you have results. :thumbsup:
